positions.title: Contract Programmer/Analyst at Sports Authority
positions.description: Assist in systems analysis and design; create batch and interactive components for new business application systems on AS/400/iSeries using RPG/IV/400 employing dynamic SQL programming techniques and CL; integrate with and maintain JDA/MMS applications; create all project documentation (functional requirements, technical specifications, QA/test documents, change control documents); coordinate production roll-out; create and maintain development environments using MKS Implementer. Primary business applications include: 3rd party data exchange integration and reporting, pricing, marketing, inventory and finance/accounting.

positions.title: Senior Programmer/Analyst-Portal Developer
positions.description: Analyze, design, create, implement, integrate and maintain batch, interactive, trigger and stored procedure applications on AS/400/iSeries using RPG/400, RPG-ILE, embedded/dynamic SQL, Stored Procedures and CL; manage, direct and participate in team oriented application systems projects including new business development, EDI using Peregrine/TrustedLink and internal/external Web Portal development using Websphere Portlet Factory Designer, Websphere Application Server, Eclipse; evaluate, integrate and customize third-party applications; create application technical specifications and user training documentation; instruct and assist in the use of in-house and third-party AS/400 and portal based software and utilities; direct and participate in programmer/analyst candidates' technical interviews. Primary business applications include: distribution, marketing, tax, credit, invoicing, inventory, resource planning and finance/accounting.

positions.title: Senior Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Direct and participate in team oriented systems analysis; design, create, implement, integrate and maintain batch and interactive application systems on AS/400/iSeries using RPG/400, RPG-ILE and CL; customize third-party applications; create application and user training documentation; instruct and assist in the use of in-house and third-party AS/400 based software and utilities.  Primary business applications include: manufacturing, resource planning, sales, payroll and finance/accounting.

positions.title: Contract Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Assist in systems analysis and design; create and integrate batch and interactive components for an EDI 214 Shipment Status system on AS/400/iSeries using RPG/IV/400 employing dynamic SQL programming techniques and CL; implement into production using client specified third party change management software.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Direct and participate in team oriented systems analysis and design; create, integrate and maintain batch and interactive student loan application systems on AS/400/iSeries using COOL:2E, COOL:Xtras CM and RPG/400 and CL; customize third-party applications to meet specific student loan processing needs; instruct and assist in the use of in-house and third-party AS/400 based software and utilities.

positions.title: Senior Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Direct team oriented systems analysis; design, create, implement, integrate and maintain batch and interactive application systems on AS/400/iSeries using RPG/400, RPG-ILE and CL, and EDI using Premenos/Harbinger; customize third-party applications; create application and user training documentation; instruct and assist in the use of in-house and third-party AS/400 based software and utilities. Primary business applications include: transportation/logistics, payroll and finance/accounting.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst/Operations Supervisor
positions.description: Participate in team oriented application systems design; create, implement and maintain application system code and databases, adhering to design specifications, integration and programming techniques on AS/400/iSeries using RPG/400, COBOL/400 and CL; supervise multiple operating systems/environments, job streams and peripheral devices: assist and instruct in the use of Island Pacific applications and all AS/400 applications and utilities. Primary business applications include: retailing, warehousing, payroll and finance/accounting.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Participate in team oriented application systems design; create, implement and maintain application system code and databases, adhering to design specifications, integration and programming techniques on AS/400/iSeries using RPG/400, RPG-II and CL /OCL; maintain multiple operating systems/environments, job streams and peripheral devices: assist and instruct in the use of all AS/400 and System 36 based applications and utilities.  Primary business applications include: transportation/logistics and finance/accounting.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst/Operations Supervisor
positions.description: Create, implement and maintain code and databases, adhering to design specifications and programming techniques on AS/400/iSeries using RPG/400, RPG-II and CL, and EDI using Harbinger/ Sterling Software; monitor, control and maintain operating system, job stream phases and peripheral devices: assist and instruct in the use of all AS/400 and PC based applications and utilities. Primary business applications include: transportation/logistics, sales and finance/accounting.
